statement: Plugin manager (/v2/owner/plugin-manager/2) shows enabled (تم التفعيل): المبيعات، الفاتورة الإلكترونية السعودية، إدارة المخزون، المالية، الحسابات العامه & القيود اليومية، العملاء، الموظفين; and disabled (تم التعطيل): دورة المشتريات، دورة الشيكات، الفروع، التصنيع، نقاط البيع، ادارة الاقساط، العروض، المبيعات المستهدفة و العمولات، SMS، المتجر الإلكترونى.

Purchase cycle (purchase request, quotation request, purchase quotation, purchase order) is a disabled app: /owner/settings/purchase_cycle only has four unchecked toggles (data[72][enable_purchase_request_manual_status], enable_quotation_request_manual_status, enable_purchase_quotation_manual_status, enable_purchase_order_manual_status) labelled حالات طلبات الشراء / حالات طلبات عروض الأسعار / حالات عروض أسعار المشتريات / حالات أوامر الشراء (custom statuses per document). The add forms of these four documents could not be opened.

GET of /v2/owner/entity/purchase_request/list, purchase_quotation/list and quotation_request/list redirected to the dashboard "/" (HTTP 200, title لوحة التحكم) while a control URL with a non-existent entity (/v2/owner/entity/zzz_nonexistent/list) returned HTTP 500 and the legacy guesses /owner/purchase_requests/add etc. returned 404.

In Daftra "فواتير الشراء" is the internal entity purchase_order: list /v2/owner/entity/purchase_order/list, add /owner/purchase_invoices/add (form PurchaseOrderForm, hidden data[PurchaseOrder][type]=0) and a second React create page /v2/owner/entity/purchase_order/create titled "إضافة | فاتورة الشراء". A real purchase order (أمر شراء) of the purchase cycle is therefore not available in this account.

Sales orders are disabled: /owner/invoices/sales_order_settings has the unchecked toggle data[Site][enable_sales_order] "نظام أوامر البيع" (dependent hidden controls: next_sales_order_number 00001, exceeding_the_sales_order_qty_in_the_sales_invoices "مسموح", apply_offers_on_sales_orders). The list /v2/owner/entity/sales_order/list shows the empty state "لم يتم إضافة اى سجلات بعد" and its button "أضف أمر البيع" links to /owner/invoices/add_sales_order, which redirected to /owner/invoices/index.

GET /owner/sales_orders/add renders the ordinary sales invoice form (title "فاتورة جديدة", form InvoiceForm posting to /owner/invoices/add, hidden data[Invoice][type]=0) with exactly the same field names and defaults as /owner/invoices/add (only the CSRF token differs): the sales-order add form is not reachable while the module is off.

The React page /v2/owner/entity/sales_order/create (title "إضافة | أمر البيع", section "معلومات أمر البيع") does render although the module is off; it is an auto-generated entity form exposing the raw schema: client_id (العميل *), no[code] (رقم الفاتورة * default 000001), date (التاريخ *), issue date (تاريخ الاصدار), due_after (labelled قيمة القسط), discount (خصم عام (نسبة)), discount_amount (خصم عام (مبلغ)), adjustment_label/adjustment_value, shipping_amount, shipping_option_id, store_id (المستودع), po_number, currency_code, order_source_id, requisitions[], html_notes, required_terms_file, draft ("Is Draft"), delivery date, client_* and client_secondary_* address fields, repeaters payment[n].*, invoice_item[n].* (item, description, unit_price, quantity, discount, discount_type, unit_factor_id, unit_factor, unit_name, unit_small_name, summary_tax1, summary_tax2, serials, tracking_data, col_3..col_8, display_order, sales_person_id, extra_details), invoice custom field and installment agreement repeaters.

Purchase credit note ("إشعار دائن" on the purchase side) is off: data[72][enable_purchase_credit_note] is unchecked in /owner/settings/purchase_invoices (next number field next_cn_number 00001 disabled); GET /owner/purchase_invoices/add_credit_note redirected to /v2/owner/entity/purchase_order/list. Sales debit note ("اشعار مدين") is off too: data[Site][enable_debit_note] unchecked in /owner/invoices/settings (next_debit_note_number 00001).

Multiple units per item (data[72][enable_multi_units]), bundles (data[72][enable_bundles], page text beside it "مسموح") and serial/batch/expiry tracking (data[72][enable_tracking_numbers]) are all unchecked in /owner/settings/inventory; the product add form therefore renders no unit, bundle or tracking control. The settings page also exposes unchecked data[72][enable_stock_requests], enable_requisitions (sales) and enable_requisitions_po (purchases), and the negative-stock radio negativeInventoryOption is on "السماح فقط للمنتجات القابلة للتتبع بالكميات".

/owner/clients/settings has these financial and identity toggles all unchecked: data[1][starting_balance] أرصدة افتتاحية، data[1][enable_client_credit_limit] الحد الائتماني، data[1][client_credit_period] المدة الائتمانية، data[1][photo]، national_id، birth_date، gender، barcode، link، multiple_addresses، map_location; client type setting is "فردي وتجاري معًا" (value 0); next client number data[1][next_auto_number] 000005 is disabled/readonly. The client add form therefore has no opening balance, credit limit, credit period, photo, national id, birth date, gender, barcode, link, multiple-address or map fields in its DOM.

No records exist for: recurring invoices (list text "لم يتم" + "اضغط هنا"), stock permits, stocktakings, receipt vouchers (سندات القبض), fixed assets, sales orders, price lists, unit templates, product categories, brands, client categories, income categories. Edit forms for these could not be opened. Existing records allowed edit forms for: estimate 13, purchase invoice 27, debit note 7, purchase refund 6, expense 1, transfer 1, treasury 1 and 3, journal 134, client 1, supplier 1, product 1.

Required fields are marked in the label with a red "*" (label text contains " *"); inputs also carry class "required" (client-side rule notEmpty, message «مطلوب» / "Required") or data-form-rules="required" (asset form). Nothing is validated on blur: focusing and tabbing out of the required client fields produced no message; messages appear only on submit (not tested, read-only).

The page-embedded translation dictionary contains the validation messages used by the sales/purchase/journal/asset forms, e.g. «مطلوب»، «هذا الحقل مطلوب»، «هذا الحقل مطلوب ولا يمكن ان يكون فارغ»، «يجب إدخال رقم بشكل صحيح»، «يجب إدخال رقم موجب»، «يجب إدخال تاريخ صحيح»، «مطلوب بريد إلكتروني صالح»، «يمكنك إضافة حتى 500 عنصر فقط»، «يمكنك إضافة حتي 10 ملفات فقط»، «يمكنك إضافة حتي 10 تنبيهات»، «لا يمكنك تحديد نفس الضريبة في مدخلات ضريبة 1 وضريبة 2»، «الايام يجب أن تكون أقل من فترة الاشتراك»، «إجمالي المدين يجب أن يكون مساوياَ لإجمالي الدائن»، «يجب أن تضيف على الأقل حركتان للقيد»، «من فضلك قم بحفظ بيانات العميل بالضغط على حفظ العميل».

Sales document drafts are auto-kept in the browser: when a new (non-edit) sales document has at least 3 item rows and a total, calculateTotals() debounced 1 s adds ?draftId=<timestamp> to the URL, appends hidden data[non_completed_id] and stores the draft in localStorage (JJLC); the journal form also reads ?draftId and posts data[non_completed_id].

Save menus: sales documents (invoice, estimate, credit note) have "حفظ كـ مسودة" + "حفظ دون طباعة" with a dropdown "حفظ دون إرسال | إرسال مع تعديل البريد | حفظ وطباعة | حفظ وإضافة جديد" (invoice/credit note) and a preview dropdown "معاينة على المتصفح | عرض PDF"; the recurring invoice has only "معاينة" and "حفظ"; purchase documents have "معاينة" + "حفظ كمسودة" + "حفظ"; expense/income/journal have "حفظ كمسودة" + "حفظ" + "خيارات اخرى" (expense/income: "حفظ & طباعة | حفظ & إضافة جديدة", journal: "حفظ & إضافة جديدة"); product has "حفظ" with dropdown "حفظ & إضافة جديدة"; stock permit "تأكيد" with dropdown "تأكيد & إضافة جديدة". Edit forms of issued purchase documents show only "معاينة" and "تحديث".

Line-grid dropdown "نسخ من جدول البيانات" (paste from spreadsheet) exists on journal lines, purchase documents and stock permits; the per-document rich text editor (html_notes, الملاحظات/الشروط) is Summernote with font-size menu 8,9,10,11,12,14,18,24,36.

Document numbering types behind the "إعدادات الترقيم المتسلسل" links (numbering/settings/<id>) read from the inline handlers: 17 = stocktaking (autoNumberSettingsStocktaking), 15 = stock transfer permit (…Requisition), 13 = outbound permit, 12 = inbound permit; the only link on the estimate settings page is 2, on the sales-order page 32, on the clients page 0. The numbering page has next_number, mode (numeric digits), digit_no (6), char_no, require_unique, add_prefix + prefix_format and prefix_serial_option (0 continue after last number, 1 separate sequence per prefix, 2 reset on prefix change).

The invoice settings page links numbering/settings/1 and 35 and the purchase settings page 5 and 36; the nearby fields are the invoice/PO number and the debit-note / credit-note next number (SiteNextDebitNoteNumber, 72NextCnNumber), so 1 and 5 are most likely invoices and purchase invoices and 35 and 36 the sales debit note and purchase credit note (order inferred, not proven).

Next numbers in this account: client 000005, supplier 000008, product 000010, sales invoice 000028, estimate 000002, purchase invoice 000025, purchase debit note 00003, purchase refund 000003, manual/auto journal 000135, expense 000003, receipt voucher 000001, asset code 000001, stocktaking 000001, stock permit 000001.

Recurring invoice add form (/owner/invoices/add_subscription, title "إضافة اشتراك", InvoiceForm multipart, hidden data[Invoice][type]=0 and page flag IS_SUBSCRIPTION) = the sales invoice form plus a card "خيارات الإصدار الآلي": الاشتراك (data[Invoice][name], text 255, required), إصدار فاتورة كل (subscription_period number default 1 + subscription_unit select days=أيام/weeks=أسابيع/months=أشهر default/years=سنوات), عدد مرات التكرار (subscription_max_repeat), تاريخ أول فاتورة (data[Invoice][date]), أصدر الفاتورة قبل (subscription_issue_before default 0), checkboxes نشط (active, checked), أرسل لى نسخة من الفاتورة المنشأة (subscription_notify), عرض تاريخ "منذ" و"حتى" في الفاتورة (show_from_to), تفعيل الدفع التلقائي لهذه الفاتورة (auto_payment).

Recurring invoice differences from the plain invoice form: no invoice number field, no issue-date field, no "التسليم" or "إيداع" tabs and no "مدفوع بالفعل" block; the deposit control is relabelled "الدفعة القادمه" (data[Invoice][deposit], deposit_type); the tab "التنبيهات الآلية" (#tab-2) is visible (hidden on the plain invoice); save buttons are only "معاينة" and "حفظ".

Client-side rules of the recurring invoice (new-invoice-v2 JS): name required; subscription period numeric and not negative; max repeat numeric and not negative (may be empty); "أصدر الفاتورة قبل" must be numeric, not negative and less than the period in days where days=1, weeks=7, months=30, years=365 (message «الايام يجب أن تكون أقل من فترة الاشتراك»).

Automatic reminders tab ("التنبيهات الآلية", up to 10 rows): empty state «لم تعد أي تنبيهات آلية حتى الآن / اضغط هنا لإنشاء تنبيه جديد», button "إضافة تذكير"; a row has data[InvoiceReminder][n][send_when] (options: 0=في تاريخ الإصدار, 1=في تاريخ الفاتورة, 2=في تاريخ الاستحقاق, 3=قبل ميعاد الفاتورة (عدد أيام), 4=بعد ميعاد الفاتورة (عدد أيام); placeholder اختر متى), [days] (visible only for 3 and 4, then required numeric not negative) and [email_template_id] (default option "استخدم القالب الافتراضي").

No recurring invoice exists in the account (list /owner/invoices/subscriptions empty with link "اضغط هنا لإنشاء فواتير دورية"), so the edit form and the statuses/columns of generated invoices could not be observed.

Estimate add form (/owner/invoices/add_estimate, title "عرض سعر جديد") is the invoice form with hidden data[Invoice][type]=3; relabelled رقم عرض الأسعار (default 000002), تاريخ عرض الأسعار, and "صالح لمدة" in place of شروط الدفع (same field data[Invoice][due_after]); issue date hidden; no "التسليم" and "إيداع" tabs; no "مدفوع بالفعل" block; layout options "التصميم الافتراضي لعرض الأسعار | التصميم الافتراضي للوقت". Tabs: الخصم والتسوية، بيانات الشحن، إرفاق المستندات.

Estimate statuses (filter payment_status on /owner/invoices/estimates): 0=مفتوح, 1=تم الإرسال, 2=تمت مشاهدته, 3=تم الرد, 4=تمت الموافقة, 5=حولت لفاتورة, 6=تم الطلب, -1=مسودة. The status is not a field of the add/edit form (it is set from list/view actions); settings: SiteDisableEstimateModule "نظام عروض الأسعار" checked, next_estimate_number 000002, apply_offers_on_estimates unchecked.

Estimate edit form (/owner/invoices/edit_estimate/13) has the same controls as the add form plus data[InvoiceItem][n][invoice_item_id], extra_details JSON containing client_balance, invoice_version, uuid, client_is_government_entity, client_identifier_type, and group_price_id "NaN"; save buttons: معاينة, حفظ دون طباعة (menu: حفظ دون إرسال | إرسال مع تعديل البريد | حفظ وطباعة) with no "حفظ كـ مسودة".

Sales invoice header fields (/owner/invoices/add, hidden type 0): قالب الفاتورة (invoice_layout_id: 0=التصميم الافتراضي للفاتورة, -1=التصميم الافتراضي للوقت), الطريقة (is_offline 0=أرسل عبر البريد, 1=طباعة default), العميل * (client_id, searchable select "enter name, phones, barcode or ID", button جديد opens inline client fields, shortcut ALT+N), العملة * (currency_code default SAR, option "العملة الأساسية" + 160 codes; hidden at load, a link with tooltip «تعديل العملة» sits beside the client field), رقم الفاتورة (data[Invoice][no] default 000028, readonly attribute set at load although the setting edit_invoice_number is checked), تاريخ الفاتورة, مسئول مبيعات, تاريخ الإصدار, شروط الدفع (due_after, days).

Sales document line columns (data[InvoiceItem][n]): item (البند), product_id hidden, description (الوصف), unit_price (سعر الوحدة), quantity (الكمية), discount + discount_type (1=% default, 2=$), tax1 and tax2 (options: بدون ضريبة default, القيمة المضافة, إعدادات الضرائب = -1 opens the taxes settings), store_id and sales_person_id (hidden at load), custom columns col_3..col_5 (hidden); the grid allows at most 500 rows.

Sales document totals tab "الخصم والتسوية": data[Invoice][discount] (percent) or data[Invoice][discount_amount] (fixed) chosen by a UI select (name discount_type, outside the data[...] namespace) with options نسبة مئوية (%) | المبلغ; التسوية = adjustment_label (text) + adjustment_value (number). Tab "بيانات الشحن": shipping_options (آلي | لا تظهر | أظهر عنوان العميل | أظهر عنوان العميل الثانوي) + shipping_amount. Tab "التسليم": is_received "تأكيد التسليم" (checked by default, consistent with the checked setting deliver_invoices_by_default «اعتبار فواتير المبيعات مُسلَّمة تلقائيًا») + received_date. Tab "إيداع": Deposit[is_paid] "(مدفوع بالفعل )", deposit amount, deposit_type, treasury (خزينة), payment method (وسيلة دفع), transaction id (رقم المعرف).

Sales document computation in client JS (calculateTotals): line = qty×unit_price; line discount type 2 = discount×qty/unit_factor, type 1 = % of line; document percent discount applies to each line net of line discount (kept unrounded); a fixed document discount is converted to a percent = discount_amount ÷ (sum of lines after line discount) × 100; included taxes: net = line − (Σincluded% ÷ (Σincluded%+100)) × line; tax1 and tax2 are each computed on the net (parallel, not compound); total = Σ(net + non-included tax) + shipping (+ non-included shipping tax) + adjustment (only if total>0) − retention (only if total>0) + extra account lines.

Sales document client-side validation (validateFields): client required; header tax1/tax2/adjustment/retention numeric; document discount numeric and ≤ 100; due_after and issue_before numeric and not negative; date and issue date required; item name required (unless template); item description max 100000 chars; unit price and quantity numeric; a line cannot use the same tax in tax1 and tax2; deposit: if deposit_type=2 it must be between 0 and 100 else ≤ document total; terms: if TextCheckbox ticked a terms template is required; each reminder needs send_when and days for types 3/4; multiple payment rows need treasury, method and amount; cost-centre rows need percentage and amount; inline new client must be saved first («من فضلك قم بحفظ بيانات العميل بالضغط على حفظ العميل»).

Sales document status texts computed live: paid = 0 → «Unpaid», 0 < paid < total → «Partial Paid», else «Paid»; "الدفعة القادمة" (Next Payment) row shows an unpaid deposit and is not a payment; checking "مدفوع بالفعل" (Payment[is_paid]) sets paid = total and reveals وسيلة دفع / رقم المعرف / خزينة (treasury options Main Treasury, افتراضي-S35 بنك; method options only نقدي).

Invoice number rule: the setting "تعديل رقم الفاتورة يدوياً" (edit_invoice_number) is checked, "معاينة الفاتورة قبل الحفظ" checked, "تبويب الربح في الفاتورة" unchecked, "الدفعات المقدمة" (enable_advance_payment) unchecked, "الحد الأقصى لنسبة الخصم" unchecked, "دفع الفاتورة تلقائيا في حالة وجود رصيد للعميل" checked, discount_option = 3 "خصم على إجمالي الفاتورة ولكل بند معًا", default_sales_tax1_mode = product ("مطابق لضريبة المنتج"), require_tax_1 unchecked.

Treasury transfer form (/owner/treasuries/transfer?from_treasury_id=N, form posts to /owner/treasuries/transfer, submit button "التحويل"): panel "من:" خزينة (data[Treasury][from_treasury_id], required class, options اختر الخزينة + Main Treasury + افتراضي-S35 بنك), العملة (from_currency_code, hidden unless multi-currency), المبلغ (data[Treasury][balance], ph 0.00), المتاح قبل / المتاح بعد (disabled calculated); panel "إلى:" خزينة (to_treasury_id), عملة الصرف (to_currency_code, hidden), سعر الصرف (currency_rate default 1, hidden), المتاح قبل/بعد; then تاريخ التحويل (transfer_date default now with time, class required), الملاحظات (notes, class required), المرفقات.

Transfer form JS keeps currency_balances per treasury and currency embedded in the page ({"1":{"SAR":84624.25},"3":{"SAR":40}}) and computes from_after = from_balance − amount and to_after = to_balance + amount × currency_rate; both selects list both treasuries (Main Treasury, افتراضي-S35 بنك) and the source is preselected from the query string.

Transfer edit page /owner/treasuries/edit_transfer/1 uses the same controls (form id Treasury/editTransfer/Form, posting /owner/treasuries/edit_transfer/1) with stored amount 10, to-treasury 3, note «افتراضي-S35 تحويل (أ) 10»; its journal (قيد 134) opens as an automatic entry with button "عرض المصدر" linking to /owner/treasuries/edit_transfer/3.

Purchase invoice add form (/owner/purchase_invoices/add, PurchaseOrderForm, hidden type 0): قالب فواتير الشراء, المورد* (searchable "أدخل الاسم، الهاتف أو الرقم التعريفي", inline new supplier fields), العملة * (default SAR), رقم فاتورة الشراء (data[PurchaseOrder][no], default 000025, required), التاريخ, شروط الدفع (due_after), hidden po_number "رقم فاتورة الشراء" (supplier reference); items data[PurchaseOrderItem][n]: item, description, store_id, unit_price, quantity, discount + discount_type (1=% default, 2=$), tax1, tax2; tabs الخصم والتسوية (discount percent or amount), إيداع (deposit amount + deposit_type المبلغ/نسبة مئوية (%) + مدفوع بالفعل + وسيلة دفع cash/cheque/bank + رقم المعرف + خزينة), الشحن (shipping_tax_id الضرائب + shipping_amount), إرفاق المستندات.

Purchase invoice payment/receipt block: checkbox data[Payment][is_paid] "تم الدفع بالفعل إلى المورد" is CHECKED by default (consistent with the checked setting po_always_paid «إجعل الفواتير مدفوعه بالفعل افتراضياً») and shows وسيلة دفع (only نقدي), رقم المعرف, خزينة; data[PurchaseOrder][is_received] "مستلم" CHECKED by default (consistent with the checked setting po_received «إجعل فواتير المشتريات مستلمة بالفعل افتراضياً») with تاريخ الإستلام (received_date default now, shown only while مستلم is ticked). Other purchase settings: next_po_number 000025, automatic_pay_po checked, update_product_prices unchecked, enable_purchases_adjustment unchecked, enable_purchase_manual_status unchecked, purchase_discount_option 3, default_purchase_tax_1_behavior = product.

Purchase document client-side validation: number, supplier and hidden currency required (message «هذا الحقل مطلوب ولا يمكن ان يكون فارغ»); date required and valid; discount numeric ≤ 100; due_after/issue_before numeric ≥ 0; item name required; unit price/qty numeric; deposit % between 0 and 100 or amount ≤ total; multiple payment rows need method, treasury, amount; sum over selected gateways must equal the invoice total; inline supplier must be saved first (message «من فضلك قم بحفظ بيانات المورد بالضغط على حفظ المورد»).

Purchase document types share one form class: hidden data[PurchaseOrder][type] = 0 purchase invoice, 6 purchase refund (/owner/purchase_invoices/add_refund, "مرتجع مشتريات جديد"), 14 debit note (/owner/purchase_invoices/add_debit_note, "إشعار مدين جديد"). Labels change: رقم الارتجاع (default 000003) / تاريخ الارتجاع; رقم الاشعار المدين (default 00003) / تاريخ الاشعار المدين; layout label قالب فواتير المرتجع.

Purchase debit note add form = purchase invoice form minus: شروط الدفع, po_number, the إيداع tab and the whole payment block (no "تم الدفع بالفعل", no treasury); keeps مستلم (data[PurchaseOrder][is_received], UNCHECKED by default here, ticking it reveals تاريخ الإستلام); tabs الخصم والتسوية، الشحن، إرفاق المستندات.

Purchase refund add form = purchase invoice form minus شروط الدفع and po_number; the payment checkbox is relabelled "تم رد المبلغ الإجمالي للبنود المرتجعة من المورد" and is unchecked by default (ticking it reveals وسيلة دفع, رقم المعرف, خزينة); keeps the إيداع tab and مستلم (unchecked by default, ticking reveals تاريخ الإستلام).
Purchase edit forms: /owner/purchase_invoices/edit/27, edit_debit_note/7, edit_refund/6 use the same controls; buttons are only "معاينة" and "تحديث" (no draft save for issued documents).

Asset depreciation card: طريقة الإهلاك * options القسط الثابت (1), القسط المتناقص (نسبة) (2), وحدات الإنتاج (3), بدون إهلاك (4). Fixed: تكرار الإهلاك التلقائي * (period number default 1 + interval الشهر|يوم|الأسبوع), قيمة الإهلاك الآلية لكل n * (amount), تاريخ بدء الإهلاك التلقائي * (default today), تاريخ انتهاء الإهلاك, قيمة الخردة, حساب مجمع الإهلاك, حساب مصروف الإهلاك. Declining: same but نسبة الإهلاك الآلية لكل n * (percentage) instead of amount. Units of production: السعر بالوحدة *, اسم الوحدة الأكبر, إجمالي وحدات الأصل and end date only. None: hides salvage value and both depreciation accounts.

Asset JS rules: next depreciation amount shown as "قيمة اول إهلاك" = fixed: amount × (firstPeriod ÷ period); percentage: pct/100 × (purchase value − salvage) × (firstPeriod ÷ period); capped at (purchase value − salvage); firstPeriod = months difference (server call /assets/get_diff_in_months), days, or weeks between in-service date and first depreciation date; default first depreciation date = in-service date + period (month addition clamps to month end). Field rules (data-form-rules): required on name, code, in-service date, purchase value, currency, purchase date, cash account, depreciation method, cost per unit, period, interval, amount, percentage, next date; requireAssetUnitsWhenToggleOn on quantity; distinctSerialNumber|requireSerialOrBarcode on unit serial; distinctBarcode on unit barcode; requiredIfCustodyTypeEmployee on unit employee. Messages: «يرجى إدخال الرقم التسلسلي أو الباركود. لا يمكن ترك الحقلين فارغين», «هذا الرقم التسلسلي مستخدم مسبقًا…», «هذا الباركود مستخدم مسبقًا…», «.يرجى اختيار الموظف عند إسناد الأصل إلى موظف».

Manual journal add (/owner/journals/add, JournalOwnerAddForm): header التاريخ (default today), العملة (select default SAR ريال سعودي, 160 options without a placeholder), رقم (default 000135), الوصف, المرفقات; lines table columns اسم الحساب * (placeholder الحساب الافتراضي, ajax search; query "1" returned 33 accounts such as 120101 - الخزينة الأساسية, 411 - المبيعات, 12041001 - شركة النور للتجارة and no parent group account like 12 or 11), الوصف (class required), مركز التكلفة, الضرائب (options - and القيمة المضافة), مدين *, دائن *; two lines by default; total row; buttons حفظ كـمسودة, إلغاء, حفظ, خيارات اخرى (حفظ & إضافة جديدة), row menu "نسخ من جدول البيانات".

Journal client rules: entering a debit zeroes the credit of the same line and vice versa; empty debit/credit become 0 on submit and must be non-negative («يجب إدخال رقم موجب»); date required and valid; at least 2 lines (#transactionsCount > 1, «يجب أن تضيف على الأقل حركتان للقيد»); |debit_total − credit_total| < 0.0001 else «إجمالي المدين يجب أن يكون مساوياَ لإجمالي الدائن»; if totals differ but match after re-rounding to the currency decimals the form appends hidden data[force_rounding]=1 and accepts; cost-centre selects marked data-required must be filled when distribution is required.

Journal line tax logic (inline JS): per line tax id from the tax select; if the tax is included (included=1) net = amount ÷ (1 + p/100) rounded to the currency decimals and tax = amount − net; otherwise tax = round(amount × p/100); line total = net + tax; debit_total and credit_total are sums of those line totals (subtotals shown separately); currency decimals come from number_formats[currency][0] (default 2).

Journal settings (/owner/settings/accounting_general): tax_in_journals "الضريبة" checked, display_cost_centers_in_journals "مركز التكلفة" checked, enable_tags_in_journal "وسوم" unchecked, separate_manual_journal_numbering unchecked (next journal number 000135), update_journal_entries_currency_rates = "عرض" (show currency-rate field) selected there but the same key shows "اخفاء" selected on /owner/invoices/settings, line account/cost-centre-distribution toggles for sales invoices, purchase invoices and stock permits unchecked, allow_cost_center_distribution_exceed_100 and require_cost_center_distribution unchecked. Inline cost-centre distribution (journal and documents): rows with percentage and credit amount (data[CostCenterTransaction*][...][percentage|credit]); selecting accounts triggers POST /owner/cost_centers/get_auto_for_account/<id> and /owner/cost_centers/add_cost_center/<id>/<credit|debit>?ajax=1 which our read-only guard blocked (no data written).

Inline "جديد" client block inside sales documents posts the client with the document: data[Invoice][client_type] radio (2 فردي, 3 تجاري), client_business_name *, client_first_name, client_last_name, client_email * (required for the print/e-mail method), client_building_no, client_address1, client_address2, client_city (الحي), client_state (المدينة), client_postal_code, client_short_address, client_phone1, client_phone2, client_country_code (SA), client_is_government_entity, client_bn1, client_identifier_type (12 options incl. CRN, NAT, IQA, GCC, PAS, OTH), client_bn2, client_active_secondary_address "إضافة عنوان شحن" with client_secondary_* (name, building, street, sub-number, district, city, postal code, short address, country), UpdateClientData "تحديث معلومات العميل"; hidden Client[client_from_data], address_id, group_price_id.

Inline new-supplier block inside purchase documents: supplier_business_name *, first/last name, supplier_email, building, street, sub-number, district, city, postal code, short address, phone1, phone2, country (SA), supplier_bn1 (الرقم الضريبي (اختياري)), supplier_bn2 (سجل تجارى/ رقم موحد (اختياري)), UpdateSupplierData "تحديث بيانات المورد"; hidden Supplier[supplier_from_data]=1, supplier_default_currency_code.

Taxes settings page (/owner/taxes/index): table columns الضريبة / قيمة الضريبة (%) / متضمنة (select غير متضمن=0 | متضمن=1) with one active tax «القيمة المضافة» 15, not included; the tax selects in all forms list only this tax plus the shortcut «إعدادات الضرائب» (-1) (documents) or «بدون ضريبة» (purchase tax on product).

Barcode/product settings (/owner/settings/product_settings): barcode_type Code 128 selected (alternative EAN13), embedded_barcode "باركود متضمن الوزن" unchecked with hidden embedded_barcode_format, weight_unit_divider, currency_divider, scale_barcode_behavior (merge default / separate). Inventory defaults page: default tax 1 = القيمة المضافة, tax 2 none, default warehouse none, refund_receipt_calculation_method = حسب سعر البيع (0) vs آخر متوسط للتكلفة (1), sold_item_type = منتجات وخدمات.

Document-level discount control in sales and purchase documents: tab "الخصم والتسوية" has a UI select (name discount_type, outside the data[...] namespace) with options نسبة مئوية (%) | المبلغ; choosing المبلغ swaps the visible input from [discount] (percent) to [discount_amount]; the sales tab adds التسوية (adjustment_label + adjustment_value), the purchase tab has no adjustment (setting enable_purchases_adjustment unchecked) and its shipping tab adds a tax select.

Treasury list filters and types: Treasury[type] 3 = cash treasury, 1 = bank account; list columns filter by الاسم, النوع, عملة and active; treasuries 1 (Main Treasury, balance 84624.25 SAR in currency_balances) and 3 (افتراضي-S35 بنك, 40 SAR) exist; permission selects only render "الكل" (-1).

Journal numbering: automatic and manual journals share one counter, next number 000135 (separate_manual_journal_numbering unchecked; the "الرقم التسلسلي للقيد اليومي التالي" field is disabled), and the manual journal form default رقم is that number.

Requisition line grid: item (البند, read-only text bound to a product picker), unit_price (default 0), quantity (الكمية); computed columns رصيد المخزن قبل / رصيد المخزن بعد / الإجمالي; page JS shows «Stock Level After» and «Available Level After» via invoic-inventory; tracking messages «Serial number already exists» / «You cannot choose more than» appear only when serial tracking is on.
